🎛 Dashboard Bot

Status, profit closed/all, winrate, best pair. Start / Stop / Pause langsung dari HP.

📋 Trades

Open trades + closed terakhir. Force-exit per trade, force-enter pair baru.

📊 Market Live

Harga Binance publik tanpa API key. Candlestick 15m / 1h / 4h / 1d, cari pair instan.

🤖 Paper Bot (offline)

Simulasi di HP: stake USDT, sinyal otomatis, backtest + max drawdown.

🔌 Konek Server

Login JWT ke http://IP:8080/api/v1/. Config tersimpan aman di DataStore.

🛡 Aman

Jangan expose API ke internet. Pakai VPN/Tailscale + password kuat + firewall.

Download / Build APK

  1. Source native ada di freqtrade-android/ (Kotlin + Compose, minSdk 26).
  2. Build lokal: gradle-8.7 + Android SDK 34 → ./gradlew assembleDebug
  3. Hasil: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk → install di HP (aktifkan “Unknown sources”).

Arsitektur yang benar: bot tetap jalan di VPS/PC 24/7, APK jadi remote + paper-trading. Bot on-device tidak disarankan (baterai + selalu online).

Di APK buka menu Server → isi Base URL http://IP-VPS:8080 + username/password → Simpan & Connect.
